## Current truth

- Network: VOID Mainnet-0, chain ID 2050.
- This site is static and read-only.
- Work Credit earning is a bounded coordinator-ticket / verified-receipt pilot.
- WC has no fixed WC-to-VOID conversion or redemption ratio.
- Public presale intake and production WC/VOID activation are coupled and currently HOLD.
- Automatic Buy VOID fulfillment is not enabled.
- Public active-validator admission is not enabled.
- No official stable VOID node release is published at this review.

## Runtime services

No current remote MCP endpoint, A2A endpoint, or external paid-work submission
endpoint is advertised by this mirror. July 2026 Cloudflare Quick Tunnel records
are historical, ephemeral verification artifacts only.

## Boundary

No wallet, signer, ledger write, transaction, payment execution, validator
mutation, Work Credit write, treasury action, market activation, or funds
movement authority is granted here.
